reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many downstream services including productcatalogservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, recommendationservice, and shippingservice, while those downstream services have low p95 latencies themselves.

Frontend's own p95 latency is very high at 1297.97ms, but all downstream services show low server-side p95 latencies (e.g., productcatalogservice 0.48ms, currencyservice 0.47ms, checkoutservice 9.91ms), indicating frontend is slow before sending requests, consistent with resource exhaustion.
CPU usage of frontend is 0.007 cores out of 0.010 cores limit, which is 71% of its CPU limit, indicating CPU throttling and resource exhaustion at frontend.
Frontend was recently recreated 331 seconds ago with a CPU limit change from 200m to 10m, which likely caused the resource exhaustion and latency increase.
No other service shows multiple slow inbound edges or high error rates converging on them, so frontend is the root cause.
The 7.7% errors on frontend->adservice are downstream symptoms, not root cause, as adservice itself has no server-side metrics and is not on the critical path.
